d: 🚀 Ready to Lead a High-Impact Data Privacy Programme?

Take the lead in coordinating the day-to-day delivery of Ooredoo FinTech International’s Data Privacy Programme. You’ll bring together policy, process, and technology workstreams to address regulatory requirements and internal audit findings, working closely with business and technical owners to turn agreed actions into measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on delivery role for an experienced Project Manager who can create structure across complex workstreams, maintain momentum, remove blockers, and ensure that each milestone is supported by clear evidence of completion.
q: At least seven years of project management experience, including delivery within banking, fintech, or another regulated environment.
Proven experience delivering data privacy, data governance, regulatory compliance, or related technology programmes across multiple functions.
Working knowledge of consent management, data subject requests, data classification, retention, and security controls.
Experience in Qatar’s financial-services environment or with Qatar Central Bank requirements is preferred.
Strong programme planning, stakeholder management, delivery coordination, and executive reporting skills.
Proven ability to manage complex dependencies, competing priorities, risks, costs, and cross-functional commitments.
Confidence working with senior business, compliance, and technical stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and project-tracking tools.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
r: Build and maintain an integrated programme plan across all work packages, clearly distinguishing discovery, policy approval, and implementation milestones.
Track milestones, dependencies, resources, costs, actions, and delivery commitments to keep the programme on course.
Identify and resolve delivery blockers, escalating risks, issues, and decisions promptly when required.
Coordinate delivery across Risk & Compliance, Legal, Product, Technology, Data Management, Operations, and external suppliers.
Confirm accountable owners, delivery commitments, dependencies, and expected outcomes across each workstream.
Keep stakeholders aligned through structured follow-up, clear communication, and timely decision-making.
Run programme reviews and maintain clear governance routines across the delivery lifecycle.
Prepare concise, decision-focused progress reports for the Programme Sponsor, PMO, and management committees.
Provide visibility into progress, risks, costs, dependencies, decisions, and upcoming priorities.
Coordinate approved technology changes with technical owners across requirements, development, integration, testing, control validation, deployment, and operational handover.
Ensure technology deliverables remain aligned with programme objectives, regulatory requirements, and agreed control outcomes.
Maintain clear completion evidence for delivered actions and programme outcomes.
Work closely with Risk & Compliance to track and support the closure of regulatory commitments and internal audit findings.
At Ooredoo Fintech, you’ll have the opportunity to
🌍 Work across markets — collaborate with diverse teams and customers.
💡 Build what’s next — contribute to innovative Fintech and digital solutions.
📈 Make an impact — see your ideas turn into real business outcomes.

d: To support the Manager and Senior Manager in preparing accurate, timely and compliant financial statements, financial reporting schedules, accounting reconciliations, tax schedules and audit support documentation. The role supports monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities, interprets and applies IFRS requirements, ensures accounting entries and tax-related deliverables are properly supported, and liaises with internal teams, external auditors, state auditors and tax stakeholders to ensure smooth reporting and compliance processes.
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or a relevant field. ACCA or an equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Technical Skills: Knowledge of VAT, income tax, accounting principles, IFRS, Oracle Financials, MS Office especially Excel, analytical thinking, problem solving and good written and oral communication skills.
r: Gather, review and analyse subsidiaries’ and associates’ financial statements, reporting packs and performance results to support group reporting and management review.
Prepare monthly variance analysis for subsidiaries, associates and key financial statement line items, including clear explanations of major movements against budget, forecast and prior periods.
Maintain subsidiary-level reports, performance dashboards, financial schedules and supporting analyses to ensure timely and accurate visibility of subsidiary and associate results.
Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements, reporting schedules, disclosure notes and working papers in line with reporting timelines.

Prepare supporting schedules for financial statement captions including revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses, finance income and cost, receivables, payables, provisions, leases, borrowings, investments and related party balances.
Review trial balance movements, balance sheet accounts, income statement movements and key account balances to identify discrepancies, unusual trends and required corrective actions.

Perform monthly closing checks to ensure all accruals, prepaid expenses, provisions, reclassifications, eliminations and adjustment entries are recorded accurately and supported by proper documentation.
Prepare and review balance sheet integrity checks, account reconciliations, intercompany reconciliations, accounting schedules and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Follow up with business units and finance teams on long-outstanding balances, unreconciled items, ageing issues and required corrective actions to improve balance sheet quality.
Prepare, post and validate journal entries, accruals, provisions, reclassifications and month-end or year-end adjustment entries in the general ledger.
Support Oracle Financials and reporting system activities by extracting trial balances, validating ledger data, investigating mapping issues and coordinating corrections with relevant system owners.
Interpret and apply IFRS requirements to accounting transactions, subsidiary reporting, consolidation inputs and financial statement disclosures, escalating complex matters where required.

Support IFRS 16 lease accounting, impairment reviews, expected credit loss schedules, revenue-related assessments and other technical accounting areas by preparing data, reconciliations and working papers.
Support consolidation and group reporting activities by preparing reporting packs, intercompany confirmations, subsidiary schedules and explanations required for consolidation review.
Coordinate with subsidiaries and associates to ensure timely submission of reporting packs, management explanations, audit requirements, tax information and supporting schedules.
Prepare ad-hoc management reports, performance summaries, financial analysis and presentation inputs to support management decision-making.

Support preparation of inputs for Audit Committee, executive management, board reporting, investor reporting and regulatory submissions by ensuring numbers are accurate, reconciled and properly explained.
Prepare VAT, withholding tax, income tax and other tax-related schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation for filing, review and compliance purposes.
Support tax return preparation, tax assessments, tax queries, tax authority requirements and tax audit responses by compiling data, reconciliations, explanations and evidence.
Coordinate with subsidiaries, associates, tax teams and relevant finance stakeholders to obtain accurate information for reporting, tax filings, tax assessments and compliance submissions.
Monitor compliance with internal financial reporting policies, delegation of authority, accounting guidelines, tax procedures and documentation requirements.
Liaise with internal auditors, external auditors, state auditors and advisors by preparing audit schedules, explanations, reconciliations and supporting evidence on a timely basis.
Track audit, state audit and tax audit requirements, maintain issue logs, follow up on open points and support timely closure of management responses and action plans.
Maintain complete and well-organised audit files, tax files, subsidiary reporting files, reconciliations, sign-offs and documentation to support reporting accuracy and audit readiness.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting templates, reconciliation processes, controls, automation, data quality and documentation standards within the financial reporting and tax processes.
Perform other related duties and ad-hoc projects as assigned, while maintaining confidentiality, professional judgement, accuracy and compliance discipline.

d: Company: Sealy Mattress Middle East Co.
Nationality Preference: Saudi, Indian, or Pakistani Nationals

Sealy Mattress Middle East Co. is seeking a qualified Senior Accountant to oversee general accounting operations, control financial transactions, and ensure regulatory compliance across our regional operations in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, extensive knowledge of KSA ZATCA regulations, and the ability to manage complex financial data to support business growth.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a highly related field. Professional certifications (e.g., SOCPA, ACCA, CMA) are highly advantageous.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of progressive corporate accounting experience , preferably within the manufacturing, retail, or distribution sectors in the GCC.
Location: Must currently reside in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia .
Nationality: Open to Saudi, Indian, or Pakistani nationals (with a transferable Iqama for expatriates).
Technical Skills: Proficiency in advanced ERP software (such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, or Microsoft Dynamics) and advanced proficiency in MS Excel.
Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of KSA ZATCA regulations, local labor laws, and IFRS standards.
r: Financial Reporting & Closing: Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes. Prepare accurate financial statements, balance sheets, and profit/loss statements in accordance with IFRS standards.
General Ledger & Reconciliation: Oversee the general ledger, perform complex bank reconciliations, review intercompany accounts, and ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded.

Taxation & ZATCA Compliance: Oversee KSA VAT compliance, including accurate calculation, preparation, and timely filing of VAT returns. Manage E-invoicing (Fatoora) requirements and support annual Zakat fillings with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA).
Accounts Payable & Receivable: Monitor cash flow, supervise aging schedules for receivables and payables, and manage vendor payments and customer invoicing structures.
Asset Management: Maintain and reconcile the fixed asset register, tracking depreciation and capital expenditures.
Audit & Support: Coordinate with internal and external auditors during annual reviews by providing required schedules, documentation, and explanations.
